notes: The colophon names no people. It has only the chapter-end formula (Anekārthadhvanimañjarī, adhyāya 3), the stock scribal verses (yādṛśaṃ pustakaṃ dṛṣṭvā…; yadi śuddham aśuddhaṃ vā…), the invocation 'rāma rāma rāma' (a deity, not a person) and a subhāṣita verse (guṇā doṣāyante…). The quoted colophon has no date. The catalogue field 'SAM 1799' does not come from this colophon, and its era is not stated. If it is VS, it would be about 1742 CE, but this is uncertain.
